releaseName: Interview guides, assistants that sign in, and held-back facts
summary: Interview preparation guides replace interview questions in the Prepare panel: you describe the interview and get a guide whose every sentence cites a career fact, an admitted gap or a research finding, as Word, PDF or Markdown (#2615-#2622, #2632). Cover letters receive the role, employer and dates, and the free-form writer repairs a dropped sentence (#2638, #2639). Assistants can connect to the remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP and sign a person in with OAuth; each connection starts runs and drafts only within the monthly spend cap you set in Workspace settings (#2609, #2646-#2648, #2655-#2658). A fact you mark for interviews only, or never, no longer reaches the CV author, with the source text it was quoted from, and a run keeps the levels it started with (#2304, #2685). Full-source evidence can be capped by cost (#2666). The History tab says how many runs suggested a writing preference (#2384, #2670). Research searches refused for quota retry once on the Claude API when that fallback is configured, and sources with a relative age get a date (#2582, #2579). Each run the worker executes now leaves a content-free trace in the database for diagnosis (#1103, #2686). Also: the theme control on Home and the career pages, the agent notes switch in Workspace settings, a capped Your files list, and a cancelled file picker that stays silent in French (#2625, #2629, #2635, #2636, #2645, #2668).
knownLimitations: Guides have not been walked with a paid run yet (#2623), and the run trace has no screen or route to read it yet. Holding back a fact withholds the whole source passage it was quoted from. The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). An essential guide costs at most US$0.20 and an extensive one US$0.40, plus research capped at US$0.08 or US$0.15. On the hosted staging service, drafting needs model screening, which stays off there until Claude on Vertex AI is available. The free-form cover letter writer is off unless a server sets DRAFT_LOOP_COVER_LETTER_WRITER=free-form. Assistant sign-in needs an identity provider, which staging does not have yet. French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The local-first desktop has no career interview or Prepare panel.
